coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required control items and the specified logarithmic latency metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100-80GB SXM4 or H100 GPUs instead of the A100-PCIE-40GB. Omits 10 measured repeated runs per task, fixed random seeds, and the same framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Ten discarded warm-up runs do not satisfy the repetition requirement. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds. Also introduces additional baselines, BoT variants, and metrics outside the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected overall increase in BoT inference time nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results, including BoT being faster than PAL on Game of 24.
